#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Get the real physical path of the script (handle soft links)
SOURCE="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
while [ -h "$SOURCE" ]; do
  DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"
  SOURCE="$(readlink "$SOURCE")"
  [[ $SOURCE != /* ]] && SOURCE="$DIR/$SOURCE"
done
SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"

# Locate the SDK root directory (since the script is in contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/tools/, the root is three levels up)
SDK_ROOT=$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../" && pwd)
NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT="$SCRIPT_DIR/nuttx_build.sh"

if [  ! -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/../toolchain" ]; then
    echo "Info: Toolchain directory not found. Setting up toolchain..."
    chmod +x $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh
    $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh 
fi
# Install commit-msg hook automatically (solution 3 implementation)
# Ensure that Change-Id can be used in the contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang project for code review
HOOKS_DIR="$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/.git/hooks"
REPO_HOOK="$SDK_ROOT/.repo/repo/hooks/commit-msg"

if [ -d "$HOOKS_DIR" ] && [ -f "$REPO_HOOK" ] && [ ! -f "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg" ]; then
    echo "Info: Installing commit-msg hook for contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang..."
    cp "$REPO_HOOK" "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
    chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
fi


# Show help message
function show_help() {
    echo "Usage: ./artbuild.sh [BOARD] [PROJECT] [OPTION]"
    echo ""
    echo "BOARD:"
    echo "  d13x_rivoride_m4-nor    Build for signal board"
    echo "PROJECT:"
    echo "  nsh         Build the project for NSH"
    echo "  nsh_cxx     Build the project for NSH with C++ 14.1 support"
    echo "  xts_opus    Build the project for XTS OPUS"
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  (none)      Build the project and pack the image (default)"
    echo "  rebuild     Clean (distclean), build the project, and pack the image"
    echo "  pack        Only pack the image"
    echo "  help        Show this help message"
    echo "  [custom]    Pass custom options directly to build.sh (e.g., clean, menuconfig)"
    echo ""
    echo "Example:"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl           # Build and pack for d13x chip (default)"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl build     # Build "
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild   # Full clean, build, and pack for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl distclean # Only run distclean via build.sh for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl clean     # Only run clean via build.sh for d13x chip"
}


if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ "$1" == "help" ] || [ "$1" == "-h" ] || [ "$1" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 1
fi

board=$1
pro=$2
if [ $# -ge 3 ]; then
opt=${@:3}
fi

# Define board configuration path for the project
BOARD_CONFIG_DIR="contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$board/configs/$pro"
CHIP_NAME=$(echo $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR | cut -d'/' -f3)
IMAGE_NAME="${CHIP_NAME}_v1.0.0.img"

echo "Building for board: $board, project: $pro, option: $opt"
echo  "BOARD_CONFIG_DIR: $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR, CHIP_NAME: $CHIP_NAME, IMAGE_NAME: $IMAGE_NAME"

# Check if help requests are made
if [ "$opt" == "help" ] || [ "$opt" == "-h" ] || [ "$opt" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 0
fi
# If no option is provided, default to build + pack
if [ -z "$opt" ]; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   exit 0
fi

# Add build option: execute build only
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "build"; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build only"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
   exit 0
fi

# Add clean option: execute distclean with path recovery
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "distclean"; then
   echo "Cleaning: distclean with path recovery"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR distclean 
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs
   rm -rf contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/prebuilt/*

fi

# Add rebuild option: execute distclean + build + pack
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "rebuild"; then
   echo "Rebuilding: distclean + build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs

   # 2. Parse defconfig to get chip absolute path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   DEFCONFIG="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/defconfig"
   if [ -f "$DEFCONFIG" ]; then
       CHIP_VAL=$(grep "^CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR=" "$DEFCONFIG" | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d '"')
       CHIP_REL=${CHIP_VAL#../} 
       CHIP_ABS="$SDK_ROOT/$CHIP_REL"

       if [ -d "$CHIP_ABS" ]; then
           echo "Runing pre-link for chip: $CHIP_ABS"
           mkdir -p nuttx/arch/risc-v/src
           ln -sf "$CHIP_ABS" nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
       else
           echo "Warning: Chip dir from defconfig not found: $CHIP_ABS"
       fi
   fi

   # 3. Parse board configuration to get Make.defs path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   MAKEDEFS_SRC="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/../../scripts/Make.defs"

   if [ -f "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" ]; then
       ln -sf "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" "$SDK_ROOT/nuttx/Make.defs"
   fi

   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ distclean -j8
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME"
   exit 0
fi

echo "Building with option: $opt"

if [ "$opt"x != "packx" ]; then
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
else
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME "
fi

function setup_cmake_binary_dir()
{
  local boardconfig=$1
  if [ -d ${ROOTDIR}/${boardconfig} ]; then
    # parse path config
    config_name=$(basename "$boardconfig")
    board_name=$(basename $(dirname $(dirname "$boardconfig")))
  else
    # parse nuttx config pair
    config_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -s -d':' -f2`
    if [ -z "${config_name}" ]; then
      board_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f1`
      config_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d'/' -f2`
    else
      board_name=`echo ${boardconfig} | cut -d':' -f1`
    fi
  fi
  CMAKE_BINARY_DIR+="/${board_name}_${config_name}"
}

  echo "Where:"
  echo "  -m: out of tree build. Or default in tree build without it."
  echo "  -e: pass extra c/c++ flags such as -Werror via make command line"
  echo "  --cmake: switch the build mode to CMake compilation."
  echo "  -b: set custom binary directory for CMake."
  echo "  --dis-ninja: disable CMake Ninja generator fo default."

  exit 1

ROOTDIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f ${0}))

      CONFIGPATH=${CONFIGPATH:0:-1}
    fi
    boarddir=`echo ${CONFIGPATH} | rev | cut -d'/' -f3 | rev`
    configdir=`echo ${CONFIGPATH} | rev | cut -d'/' -f1 | rev`
  else
    boarddir=${confparams[0]}
  fi

  OUTDIR=${ROOTDIR}/out/${boarddir}/${configdir}
  MOUNTDIR=${OUTDIR}/.unionfs
  NUTTXDIR=${MOUNTDIR}/nuttx

else

  NUTTXDIR=${ROOTDIR}/nuttx
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Get the real physical path of the script (handle soft links)
SOURCE="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
while [ -h "$SOURCE" ]; do
  DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"
  SOURCE="$(readlink "$SOURCE")"
  [[ $SOURCE != /* ]] && SOURCE="$DIR/$SOURCE"
done
SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -P "$( dirname "$SOURCE" )" && pwd )"

# Locate the SDK root directory (since the script is in contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/tools/, the root is three levels up)
SDK_ROOT=$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../" && pwd)
NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT="$SCRIPT_DIR/nuttx_build.sh"

if [  ! -d "$SCRIPT_DIR/../toolchain" ]; then
    echo "Info: Toolchain directory not found. Setting up toolchain..."
    chmod +x $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh
    $SCRIPT_DIR/env.sh 
fi
# Install commit-msg hook automatically (solution 3 implementation)
# Ensure that Change-Id can be used in the contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang project for code review
HOOKS_DIR="$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/.git/hooks"
REPO_HOOK="$SDK_ROOT/.repo/repo/hooks/commit-msg"

if [ -d "$HOOKS_DIR" ] && [ -f "$REPO_HOOK" ] && [ ! -f "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg" ]; then
    echo "Info: Installing commit-msg hook for contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang..."
    cp "$REPO_HOOK" "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
    chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/commit-msg"
fi


# Show help message
function show_help() {
    echo "Usage: ./artbuild.sh [BOARD] [PROJECT] [OPTION]"
    echo ""
    echo "BOARD:"
    echo "  d13x_rivoride_m4-nor    Build for signal board"
    echo "PROJECT:"
    echo "  nsh         Build the project for NSH"
    echo "  nsh_cxx     Build the project for NSH with C++ 14.1 support"
    echo "  xts_opus    Build the project for XTS OPUS"
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  (none)      Build the project and pack the image (default)"
    echo "  rebuild     Clean (distclean), build the project, and pack the image"
    echo "  pack        Only pack the image"
    echo "  help        Show this help message"
    echo "  [custom]    Pass custom options directly to build.sh (e.g., clean, menuconfig)"
    echo ""
    echo "Example:"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh           # Build and pack for d13x chip (default)"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh build     # Build "
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh rebuild   # Full clean, build, and pack for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh distclean # Only run distclean via build.sh for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh clean     # Only run clean via build.sh for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl           # Build and pack for d13x chip (default)"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl build     # Build "
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild   # Full clean, build, and pack for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl distclean # Only run distclean via build.sh for d13x chip"
    echo "  ./autobuild.sh d13x_rivoride_m4-nor nsh_lvgl clean     # Only run clean via build.sh for d13x chip"
}


if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ "$1" == "help" ] || [ "$1" == "-h" ] || [ "$1" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 1
fi

board=$1
pro=$2
if [ $# -ge 3 ]; then
opt=${@:3}
fi

# Define board configuration path for the project
BOARD_CONFIG_DIR="contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/boards/$board/configs/$pro"
CHIP_NAME=$(echo $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR | cut -d'/' -f3)
IMAGE_NAME="${CHIP_NAME}_v1.0.0.img"

echo "Building for board: $board, project: $pro, option: $opt"
echo  "BOARD_CONFIG_DIR: $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR, CHIP_NAME: $CHIP_NAME, IMAGE_NAME: $IMAGE_NAME"

# Check if help requests are made
if [ "$opt" == "help" ] || [ "$opt" == "-h" ] || [ "$opt" == "--help" ]; then
    show_help
    exit 0
fi
# If no option is provided, default to build + pack
if [ -z "$opt" ]; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   exit 0
fi

# Add build option: execute build only
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "build"; then
   echo "No option provided. Defaulting to: build only"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
   exit 0
fi

# Add clean option: execute distclean with path recovery
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "distclean"; then
   echo "Cleaning: distclean with path recovery"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR distclean 
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs
   rm -rf contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack/prebuilt/*

fi

# Add rebuild option: execute distclean + build + pack
if echo "$opt" | grep -qw "rebuild"; then
   echo "Rebuilding: distclean + build + pack"
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   
   # 1. Remove all conflicting files
   rm -rf nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
   rm -rf nuttx/include/arch
   rm -f nuttx/Make.defs

   # 2. Parse defconfig to get chip absolute path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   DEFCONFIG="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/defconfig"
   if [ -f "$DEFCONFIG" ]; then
       CHIP_VAL=$(grep "^CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR=" "$DEFCONFIG" | cut -d'=' -f2 | tr -d '"')
       CHIP_REL=${CHIP_VAL#../} 
       CHIP_ABS="$SDK_ROOT/$CHIP_REL"

       if [ -d "$CHIP_ABS" ]; then
           echo "Runing pre-link for chip: $CHIP_ABS"
           mkdir -p nuttx/arch/risc-v/src
           ln -sf "$CHIP_ABS" nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/chip
       else
           echo "Warning: Chip dir from defconfig not found: $CHIP_ABS"
       fi
   fi

   # 3. Parse board configuration to get Make.defs path (adapt SDK_ROOT)
   MAKEDEFS_SRC="$SDK_ROOT/$BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/../../scripts/Make.defs"

   if [ -f "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" ]; then
       ln -sf "$MAKEDEFS_SRC" "$SDK_ROOT/nuttx/Make.defs"
   fi

   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ distclean -j8
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR/ -j8
   if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
       echo "Build failed. Exiting."
       exit 1
   fi
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME"
   exit 0
fi

echo "Building with option: $opt"

if [ "$opt"x != "packx" ]; then
   cd "$SDK_ROOT"
   "$NUTTX_BUILD_SCRIPT" $BOARD_CONFIG_DIR $opt
else
   cd "$SDK_ROOT/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/pack"
   ./pack.sh $board
   cp ./prebuilt/$IMAGE_NAME "$SDK_ROOT/"
   echo "cp image completed $SDK_ROOT/$IMAGE_NAME "
fi

 */

 */

#ifdef __cplusplus

text:
这几个建议如下：

- `app/lvgldemo/.built`：**没用，建议删掉**
  这是构建过程生成的 0 字节标记文件，不是源码。提交它没有价值，还容易让评审觉得混入了构建产物。

- `app/lvgldemo/SConscript`：**可保留**
  这是 SCons 构建脚本。你当前主要走 `Makefile` / `Make.defs`，但仓库工具里确实还有 SCons 相关入口。它很小，属于源码构建配置，不是产物。除非你确定完全不用 SCons，否则保留更稳。

- `app/lvgldemo/.gitignore`：**可保留，但不是编译必需**
  它不是 `.git` 仓库文件，只是 Git 忽略规则。当前内容是忽略 `/*.zip` 和 `/lv_demos`，用于防止 LVGL demo 下载包或展开目录被误提交。保留没问题。

- `.git`：**不要删**
  如果你说的是仓库根目录的 `.git`，那是 Git 仓库数据库，保存分支、提交历史、暂存区等信息。它不会作为代码提交到 Gerrit，但本地开发必须有。  
  如果某个子目录里出现 `.git` 文件或 `.git` 目录，那通常不该提交，需要单独看。

结论：**`.built` 建议去掉；`SConscript` 和 `.gitignore` 可以保留。**

```text
autobuild.sh
```

# SPLITVARIABLE - Split long variables into specified batches
# Usage: $(call SPLITVARIABLE, variable-def, variable-ref, batch-size)
#
#	Example: VAR:= a b c x y z foo bar
#			 $(call SPLITVARIABLE, VAR, $(VAR), 3)
#			 $(foreach, num, $(VAR_TOTAL), $(shell echo $(VAR_$(num))))
#	Return new variable definition:
#		$(variable-def)_TOTAL : total split sequence , start with 1.
#		$(variable-def)_$(num) : newly defined variable , ended with batch num.
#	In the case above:
#			$(VAR_TOTAL) = 1 2 3
#			$(VAR_1) = a b c
#			$(VAR_2) = x y z
#			$(VAR_3) = foo bar

define SPLITVARIABLE
	$(eval SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX = $(1))
	$(eval BATCH_SIZE = $(3))
	$(eval TOTAL_BATCH = $(shell expr $(words $(2)) / $(BATCH_SIZE) + 1))
	$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL = $(shell seq 1 $(TOTAL_BATCH)))
	$(foreach idx, $($(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL), \
		$(eval FROMINDEX=$(shell expr 1 + $(idx) \* $(BATCH_SIZE) - $(BATCH_SIZE))) \
		$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_$(idx)=$(wordlist $(FROMINDEX), $(shell expr $(FROMINDEX) + $(BATCH_SIZE) - 1), $(2))) \
	)
endef

define ARLOCK
	flock $1.lock $(call ARCHIVE, $1, $(2))
endef

# dynamic AR target

define AROBJSRULES
$(1) : $(2)
	@ cp $(2) $(1)
endef

# CLEANAROBJS - del AR target files exclusively

ifeq ($(CONFIG_WINDOWS_NATIVE),y)
define CLEANAROBJS
	$(call DELFILE,$(subst /,\,$(AROBJS)))
	$(call DELFILE,$(subst /,\,$(OBJS)))
	$(eval OBJS :=)
endef
else
define CLEANAROBJS
	$(call SPLITVARIABLE,CLEAN_AROBJS,${AROBJS},100)
	$(foreach BATCH, $(CLEAN_AROBJS_TOTAL), \
		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_AROBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(call SPLITVARIABLE,CLEAN_OBJS,${OBJS},100)
	$(foreach BATCH, $(CLEAN_OBJS_TOTAL), \
		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_OBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(eval OBJS :=)
endef
endif

 * @file app_init.h
 * @brief Application initialization entry point.
 *
 * Single call to app_init() bootstraps the entire GUI application:
 *  - Initializes LVGL if not already done by the OS
 *  - Sets up the NuttX display and input drivers
 *  - Registers all pages with the page manager
 *  - Shows the default home page
 *
 * The NuttX main() only needs to call app_init() and then
 * enter the LVGL event loop.
 */

#ifndef APP_INIT_H
#define APP_INIT_H

/*********************
 *      INCLUDES
 *********************/
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**********************
 * GLOBAL PROTOTYPES
 **********************/

/**
 * Initialize the entire GUI application.
 * Call this from the NuttX task entry point (main).
 *
 * @return 0 on success, negative errno on failure.
 */
int app_init(void);

/**
 * Run one iteration of the LVGL event loop.
 * Call this in a loop or from a timer after app_init().
 *
 * @return Suggested idle time in milliseconds before the next LVGL tick.
 */
uint32_t app_run_once(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
} /* extern "C" */
#endif

#endif /* APP_INIT_H */

/**
 * @file page_manager.h
 * @brief Page manager - centralized page registration, navigation and lifecycle.
 *
 * Design principles:
 *  - All page transitions go through page_manager; no direct lv_scr_load()
 *    calls scattered in view or logic code.
 *  - Supports a simple page stack for push/pop navigation.
 *  - Old page is properly destroyed on transition to avoid memory leaks.
 */

#ifndef PAGE_MANAGER_H
#define PAGE_MANAGER_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/*********************
 *      INCLUDES
 *********************/
#include "app_context.h"

/**********************
 * GLOBAL PROTOTYPES
 **********************/

/**
 * Initialize the page manager. Call once during app startup.
 */
void page_manager_init(void);

/**
 * Register a page with the manager.
 * @param id       Unique page identifier.
 * @param name     Human-readable name (for debug logs).
 * @param cbs      Lifecycle callbacks (create, on_enter, on_exit, destroy).
 * @return 0 on success, -1 on failure (full or duplicate).
 */
int page_manager_register(app_page_id_t id, const char *name,
                          const app_page_cbs_t *cbs);

/**
 * Navigate to a page using the specified action.
 * @param action    PUSH, POP, REPLACE, or HOME.
 * @param target    Target page ID (ignored for POP and HOME).
 */
void page_manager_navigate(nav_action_t action, app_page_id_t target);

/**
 * Request a navigation that will be processed on the next LVGL tick.
 * Safe to call from event callbacks (non-blocking).
 * @param action    Navigation action.
 * @param target    Target page ID.
 */
void page_manager_request_nav(nav_action_t action, app_page_id_t target);

/**
 * Process any pending navigation requests. Call from the main loop
 * or a lv_timer callback.
 */
void page_manager_process_nav(void);

/**
 * Get the current active page ID.
 * @return Active page ID or APP_PAGE_ID_INVALID if none.
 */
app_page_id_t page_manager_get_current(void);

/**
 * Start showing the default (home) page.
 */
void page_manager_start(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
} /* extern "C" */
#endif

#endif /* PAGE_MANAGER_H */

/**
 * @file event_handler.h
 * @brief Central event dispatcher for application-level events.
 *
 * Events from UI controls flow through here rather than being handled
 * directly in view code. This separates "what happened" from
 * "what to do about it", keeping views thin.
 */

#ifndef EVENT_HANDLER_H
#define EVENT_HANDLER_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/*********************
 *      INCLUDES
 *********************/
#include <lvgl/lvgl.h>

/**********************
 *      TYPEDEFS
 **********************/

/**
 * Application-level event codes (beyond LV_EVENT_*, these are app-specific).
 */
typedef enum {
    APP_EVENT_THEME_TOGGLE = LV_EVENT_LAST + 1,
    APP_EVENT_CHART_PERIOD_CHANGED,
    APP_EVENT_CHART_VALUE_CHANGED,
    APP_EVENT_NAV_REQUEST,
    APP_EVENT_LAST
} app_event_code_t;

/**********************
 * GLOBAL PROTOTYPES
 **********************/

/**
 * Initialize the event handler subsystem.
 * Registers a periodic timer to process pending nav requests.
 */
void event_handler_init(void);

/**
 * Generic LVGL event callback that can be attached to any object.
 * Reads the custom event code from the event and dispatches accordingly.
 */
void event_handler_dispatch(lv_event_t *e);

#ifdef __cplusplus
} /* extern "C" */
#endif

#endif /* EVENT_HANDLER_H */

# SPLITVARIABLE - Split long variables into specified batches
# Usage: $(call SPLITVARIABLE, variable-def, variable-ref, batch-size)
#
#	Example: VAR:= a b c x y z foo bar
#			 $(call SPLITVARIABLE, VAR, $(VAR), 3)
#			 $(foreach, num, $(VAR_TOTAL), $(shell echo $(VAR_$(num))))
#	Return new variable definition:
#		$(variable-def)_TOTAL : total split sequence , start with 1.
#		$(variable-def)_$(num) : newly defined variable , ended with batch num.
#	In the case above:
#			$(VAR_TOTAL) = 1 2 3
#			$(VAR_1) = a b c
#			$(VAR_2) = x y z
#			$(VAR_3) = foo bar

define SPLITVARIABLE
	$(eval SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX = $(1))
	$(eval BATCH_SIZE = $(3))
	$(eval TOTAL_BATCH = $(shell expr $(words $(2)) / $(BATCH_SIZE) + 1))
	$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL = $(shell seq 1 $(TOTAL_BATCH)))
	$(foreach idx, $($(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_TOTAL), \
		$(eval FROMINDEX=$(shell expr 1 + $(idx) \* $(BATCH_SIZE) - $(BATCH_SIZE))) \
		$(eval $(SPLITVARIABLE_PREFIX)_$(idx)=$(wordlist $(FROMINDEX), $(shell expr $(FROMINDEX) + $(BATCH_SIZE) - 1), $(2))) \
	)
endef

		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_AROBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(call SPLITVARIABLE,CLEAN_OBJS,${OBJS},100)
	$(foreach BATCH, $(CLEAN_OBJS_TOTAL), \
		$(shell rm -rf $(CLEAN_OBJS_$(BATCH))))
	$(eval OBJS :=)
endef

# contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang

👋 欢迎参加 **2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛**！

这是组委会为你的队伍创建的**专属参赛仓库**（本仓为样例/模板，队伍编号 `052`；你看到的将是你自己的 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>`）。比赛期间，你的全部参赛代码、打包产物与 AI Coding 日志都提交到这里。

> 本仓既是「代码仓」，又内置了一键拉取整套 openvela 工程的 `repo` 清单（manifest）。你只需跟它打交道，**自始至终只动一个文件夹**。

---

## 一、先读这些官方文档

**通用（所有赛道必读）：**

| 文档                                                                                                                                     | 用途                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| [《大赛总览》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/contest_overview.md)                        | 赛道、流程、评分、资源，建议先通读             |
| [《参赛代码提交指南》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/code_submission_guide.md)           | 仓库获取、提交流程、时间与权限（**以此为准**） |
| [《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_coding_log_guide.md) | 如何导出 AI 对话日志并提交到 `logs/`           |

**按你的赛道选读（三选一）：**

| 赛道                  | 教程导航                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 快应用 / 手表应用创新 | [快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)                         |
| AI 硬件产品创新       | [AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)              |
| 新硬件适配            | [新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md) |

---

## 二、第一步：拉取完整工程

用组委会提供的命令一键拉取「openvela 全量源码 + 你的专属仓」：

```bash
repo init -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang \
  -b dev-ai-contest-2026 -m contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml
repo sync -c -j8
```

同步后，你的整个仓库位于工作区的 `contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/`，openvela 全量源码在外层（`nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/`、`vendor/` 等）。

---

## 三、第二步：在哪里写代码

**只在自己的仓目录 `contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/` 里开发。** 不同作品形态放在对应子目录，manifest 会通过 `<linkfile>` 把它们**软链**到 openvela 编译树该在的位置——你不用手动 copy：

| 作品形态 | 你的代码放这里             | 系统自动映射到                                 |
| -------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| 应用     | `app/hello_app/`           | `packages/demos/contest2026_052_hello_app`     |
| 快应用   | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_052_hello_quickapp` |
| 板级适配 | `board/contest_board/`     | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_052_board` |

> 用不到的形态目录可以删掉；新增作品时按同样规则加子目录，并在 `contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml` 里补一条 `<linkfile>` 映射即可。**生产仓库（packages/nuttx/vendor 等）零改动。**

建议仓库目录约定（便于评委定位）：

```text
app/ | quickapp/ | board/   # 你的作品代码
logs/                       # AI Coding 日志（主动导出后提交，格式见 logs/README.md）
```

## 四、第三步：编译与运行

编译/运行步骤随作品形态不同而不同，请参考你所在赛道的教程导航：

- 快应用 / 手表应用：[快应用教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/quickapp/quickapp_guide_index.md)（含模拟器与开发板部署）。
- AI 硬件产品创新：[AI 硬件赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/ai_hardware/ai_hardware_guide_index.md)（环境搭建、编译烧录、Skill 开发）。
- 新硬件适配：[新硬件适配赛道教程导航](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/zh-cn/contest_2026/hardware_porting/hardware_porting_guide_index.md)（BSP 移植、最小 NSH 基线）。

子目录已通过 manifest 中的 `<linkfile>` 软链进 openvela 编译树，因此构建在 openvela 工作区**根目录**（即你这个仓的上一级）进行。openvela 使用 `build.sh` 作为统一入口，接收一个 **board config 路径**作为参数：

```bash
# 进入 openvela 工作区根目录（你的仓的上一级）
cd ..

# 通用语法：第一个参数是 board config 路径，第二个参数可以是 menuconfig / distclean 等
./build.sh <board-config-path> [menuconfig|distclean] [-j8]
```

> 具体的 board config 路径、目标产物、模拟器/真机部署方式请以你所在赛道的教程导航为准。本仓 `app/` `quickapp/` `board/` 三个示例骨架对应的 Kconfig 选项可通过 `menuconfig` 启用。

## Adding a New Page

1. Create `views/view_mypage.c/.h` with `app_page_cbs_t` (create, on_enter, on_exit, destroy)
2. Add a `PAGE_MYPAGE` entry to the `app_page_id_t` enum in `app_context.h`
3. Register in `app_init.c`: `page_manager_register(PAGE_MYPAGE, "MyPage", view_mypage_get_cbs())`

## My request for Codex:
继续
我已经查完了。结论很简单：`app` 是真正放代码的目录，`apps` 现在只是一个很薄的编译入口/兼容包装目录。

这两个目录现在的作用是：

`app/`：真正的应用源码目录。  
现在实际有用的是 [app/lvgl_app](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app)。里面有 `lvgl_app_main.c`、`Kconfig`、`Makefile`、`Make.defs`、页面、字体、lvgldemo 适配代码，是真正被编译进去的代码。

`apps/`：现在只是一个“包装入口”目录。  
里面只有 [apps/Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/apps/Kconfig:1) 和 [apps/Make.defs](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/apps/Make.defs:1)，作用是把根目录的 `Kconfig/Make.defs` 转接到 `app/lvgl_app`。

当前真正编译链路主要是这条：

```text
contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml
  -> linkfile app/lvgl_app 到 packages/demos/contest2026_052_lvgl_app
  -> packages/demos/Kconfig source lvgl_app/Kconfig
  -> packages/demos/Make.defs include lvgl_app/Make.defs
  -> lvgl_app/Make.defs 注册 CONFIGURED_APPS
  -> lvgl_app/Makefile 编译源码
```

所以简单说：

```text
app/   = 放真实源码，有用
apps/  = 转接入口，目前不是源码目录
```

`apps/` 不是必须保留。现在它存在主要是因为根目录 [Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/Kconfig:5) 里写的是：

```text
source "$APPSDIR/../contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/apps/Kconfig"
```

如果想更干净，可以删掉 `apps/`，然后把根目录 `Kconfig/Make.defs` 直接指向 `app/lvgl_app`。不过当前编译已经正常，不删也不会出问题。`app/event_btn_test` 目前也没有接入当前主编译链路。

source "$APPSDIR/../contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Kconfig"

```text
└── app/Kconfig
    ├── XFC_USING_LVGL_APP
    │   └── app/lvgl_app/Kconfig
    └── 后续如果要接 event_btn_test，再在这里加
```

现在你只需要编译 `lvgl_app`，所以 `app/Kconfig` 里只连接 `lvgl_app/Kconfig` 就够了。`event_btn_test/Kconfig` 暂时不用接，否则它会进入配置菜单，后面也可能被打开参与编译。

可以接，但要分清楚：`event_btn_test` 是 **GPIO 按键测试**，不是 LVGL 触摸屏。LVGL 触摸现在还是走 `/dev/input0`，不需要这个模块。

我已经把它按可选层级接入了，默认关闭，不影响当前镜像：

- [app/Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Kconfig:20)：新增 `XFC_USING_EVENT_BTN_TEST`
- [app/Make.defs](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Make.defs:36)：接入 `event_btn_test/Make.defs`
- [app/event_btn_test/Make.defs](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/event_btn_test/Make.defs:7)：修正注册路径
- [app/event_btn_test/Makefile](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/event_btn_test/Makefile:3)：修正说明和 include 路径

验证结果：

```text
CONFIG_XFC_USING_LVGL_APP=y
CONFIG_APP_LVGL_APP=y
# CONFIG_XFC_USING_EVENT_BTN_TEST is not set
# CONFIG_AIC_EVENT_BTN_TEST is not set
```

重新编译通过，镜像已生成：

```text
/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/d13x_demo88-nor_v1.0.0.img
```

真正要用 `btn_test` 时，需要打开：

```text
CONFIG_XFC_USING_EVENT_BTN_TEST=y

```

然后板子启动后在 nsh 里运行：

```sh
btn_test
```

注意：源码里现在按键管脚硬编码为 [PA.0](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/event_btn_test/aic_gpio_button_test.c:26)，如果实际硬件不是这个脚，编译能过但按键不会有反应。

是的，**`app` 的 Kconfig 配置层级现在是按 `drv/Kconfig` 那种上下层关系整理的**，但要注意：`Kconfig` 负责“配置菜单/开关”，真正参与编译还要看 `Make.defs`。

当前结构是：

```text
packages/demos/Kconfig
└── packages/demos/contest2026_052_app/Kconfig
    └── 实际指向 contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Kconfig
        └── config XFC_USING_LVGL_APP
            └── if XFC_USING_LVGL_APP
                └── source app/lvgl_app/Kconfig
```

对应文件：

- [app/Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Kconfig:8)：上层总开关 `XFC_USING_LVGL_APP`
- [app/Kconfig](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/Kconfig:16)：开关打开后才 `source app/lvgl_app/Kconfig`
- [contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml:12)：把整个 `app` 挂到 `packages/demos/contest2026_052_app`

这和你选中的 `drv/Kconfig` 逻辑是一样的：

```kconfig
if AIC_SPINOR_DRV
source ".../spinor/Kconfig"
endif
```

你的 app 现在是：

```kconfig
if XFC_USING_LVGL_APP
source "$APPSDIR/../contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app/lvgl_app/Kconfig"
endif
```

真正编译链路是：

```text
contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/Make.defs
└── app/Make.defs
    └── app/lvgl_app/Make.defs
        └── CONFIG_APP_LVGL_APP=y 时注册 lvgl_app
```

所以结论：**配置层级是按 `drv/Kconfig` 那种上层总开关 -> 子目录 Kconfig 的方式做了；当前实际编译的 app 只有 `app/lvgl_app`。**

XML 指的是这个文件：

[contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml](/data/work/xinfanzhichuang_vela/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml:1)

当前内容核心是：

```xml
<include name="openvela.xml"/>

<project path="contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang" name="contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang">
  <linkfile src="app" dest="packages/demos/contest2026_052_app"/>
  <linkfile src="quickapp/hello_quickapp" dest="packages/apps/contest2026_052_hello_quickapp"/>
  <linkfile src="board/contest_board" dest="vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_052_board"/>
</project>
```

作用是告诉 `repo sync`：把你仓库里的目录软链到 openvela 编译树里。

最关键的是这一行：

```xml
<linkfile src="app" dest="packages/demos/contest2026_052_app"/>
```

意思是：

```text
contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang/app
映射到
packages/demos/contest2026_052_app
```

所以现在 openvela 的 `packages/demos/Kconfig` 读到的就是你的 `app/Kconfig`，再进入 `app/lvgl_app/Kconfig`。这行要提交，否则别人重新 `repo sync` 后，编译树不会自动挂到你现在整理好的 `app` 总入口。

对，`app/lvgldemo/SConscript` 现在没用。

你当前编译命令：

```sh
./autobuild.sh d13x_demo88-nor nsh_lvgl rebuild
```

走的是 NuttX/openvela 的 `Kconfig + Make.defs + Makefile` 链路，不走 SCons。

当前有效链路是：

```text
contest2026_052_xinfanzhichuang.xml
└── app -> packages/demos/contest2026_052_app

app/Kconfig
└── app/lvgl_app/Kconfig

app/Make.defs
└── app/lvgl_app/Make.defs

app/lvgl_app/Makefile
└── 编译 lvgl_app_main.c、app_init.c、lvgldemo_port.c ...
```

`SConscript` 是旧 `app/lvgldemo` 目录里的 SCons 构建文件。现在 `lvgldemo` 已经迁移进 `app/lvgl_app`，而且旧目录也准备删除，所以：

```text
D app/lvgldemo/SConscript
```

这个删除可以提交，不需要保留。

同理，`app/lvgldemo/CMakeLists.txt` 对当前这条编译链路也不是必需的。当前真正需要的是 `Makefile` / `Make.defs` / `Kconfig`。
